text: If the Contractor fails to achieve Taking-Over within the Time for Completion, it shall pay delay damages of 0.1 % of the Contract Price per day of delay. Delay damages are capped at 10 % of the Contract Price. If first synchronisation in combined cycle is delayed by more than 60 days beyond its Key Date, interim delay damages of 0.05 % per day apply, to be credited against final delay damages.
title: Delay damages
